contractReference.note: Full contract bytes read at PR head 0b4d4951d42c67d39cce59b238f5d30497e156b9; Git blob independently matched. The six required fields and SHA-256 route-config rule are observed source, not deployed execution evidence.

validator.abstentionSemantics: Any structural break in binding, capture, readout, witness, ordering, or cross-reference yields UNVERIFIED with a named failure code. There is no partial credit.

readoutContractReference.note: Observed canonical joinKey captureReceipt and method/coverage/disposition requirements. Contract unchanged.

wireProfile.scope: Concrete structural representation of the two observed prose contracts. Passing verifies shape and internal correspondence only, never authenticity, source admission, execution or production.
wireProfile.configurationAndEvidenceDigests: routeConfigHash, capture configHash, parametersHash and evidenceHash use lowercase SHA-256 (64 hex). ImplementationRevision is a separate Git SHA-40.
wireProfile.routeDescriptor: routeName, routeId, routeConfigHash; bindingReceipt repeats routeId and routeConfigHash for structural agreement.
wireProfile.bindingReceipt: dsseId, reverifiedAtCallTime=true, verifiedAt. The UTC timestamp equals the bind-stage instant; the declaration is NOT cryptographic re-verification.
wireProfile.captureAnchor: receiptId, configHash, joinedToBindingReceipt=true, bindingReceiptId. The receipt id is distinct from its config digest.
wireProfile.readoutReceipt: receiptId, captureReceipt=the capture receiptId, keystoneConformant=true, ordersAfterCapture=true; legacy captureAnchorRef is rejected. Binding/capture/readout receipt IDs are distinct.
wireProfile.readoutMethod: name, implementationRevision (Git SHA-40), parametersHash (SHA-256). These are declared pins; source/parameter bytes are not fetched.
wireProfile.coverageMap: captureConfigHash, nonempty unique layers and hookPoints lists (at most128 each), state FULL or PARTIAL. The checker preserves declared partial coverage, not measurement truth.
wireProfile.dispositionField: property, state MEASURED or UNAVAILABLE, method matching readoutMethod.name, captureReceiptId, failureCode null for MEASURED and nonempty for UNAVAILABLE. Aggregate VERIFIED refuses failed readouts; caller MEASURED is not upgraded to verified measurement.
wireProfile.unavailableSemantics: directedModulation, internalReasoning, generalization must each be UNAVAILABLE; these named properties cannot have a MEASURED disposition.
wireProfile.timestamps: Exact UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ with valid calendar roundtrip. Exactly bind,capture,readout in strictly increasing order. No clock truth/freshness claim.
wireProfile.inputBounds: CLI: one regular non-leaf-symlink file;64KiB UTF-8;16 nesting levels;4096 JSON values. Reject duplicate decoded keys, nonfinite numbers, malformed/trailing input. Detect observed file size/time movement. Not an atomic hostile-filesystem snapshot or a JavaScript sandbox.
wireProfile.order: Retains the existing six-field top-level ordering rule as a property of this profile, not a general JSON ordering guarantee.
wireProfile.output: Every result has scope STRUCTURE_ONLY and executionVerified, dsseVerified, evidenceBytesVerified, productionAuthorized=false. Input state cannot override these fields.

claimSurfaces: No execution has run; no bound route exists; no executional receipt has been emitted. Every estate organ remains MODELED or NO_ORGAN.
This wave ships a structural checker only; it inspects a witness bundle's shape against the contract's six fields and validates nothing about any deployed system.

The checker does not and cannot prove a route exists, a DSSE envelope verifies, or timestamps are truthful; it only enforces that a claimed witness bundle is internally complete and ordered before any deeper verification lane consumes it.
A passing structural check is a precondition for evaluation, not evidence of executional satisfaction.
If the checker and an executor disagree, that is evidence of route or record drift, never of success.

relationToLane.rule: Claim graduation happens only by a new wave receipt citing a witness record that passes every contract field; this checker is one input to that evaluation, never the graduation itself.
